<robot name="sliding_door_cabinet">

  <material name="carcass_mat">
    <color rgba="0.60 0.45 0.30 1.0"/>
  </material>
  <material name="door_mat">
    <color rgba="0.85 0.75 0.60 1.0"/>
  </material>

  <!-- Cabinet carcass: 1.77 m wide (X), 0.37 m deep (Y), 1.94 m tall (Z).
       Overall footprint including doors spans Y = -0.205 .. +0.205 (0.41 m).
       Front faces -Y. Link origin is on the floor under the middle of the object. -->
  <link name="cabinet_body">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.02 0.97" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="45.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="14.6269" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="25.8619" iyz="0.0"
               izz="12.2618"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.02 0.97" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.77 0.37 1.94"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="carcass_mat"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.02 0.97" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.77 0.37 1.94"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Left door, outer (front) track. Closed: covers X = -0.89 .. +0.01 -->
  <link name="door_left">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="8.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="2.4069" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="2.9467" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.5403"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.90 0.02 1.90"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="door_mat"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.90 0.02 1.90"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Right door, inner (rear) track. Closed: covers X = -0.01 .. +0.89 -->
  <link name="door_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="8.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="2.4069" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"

      <geometry>
        <box size="0.90 0.02 1.90"/>
      </geometry>

  </link>

  <!-- Outer track door: slides in +X, passing in front of the inner door -->
  <joint name="door_left_slide" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="door_left"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.44 -0.195 0.97" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="0.88" effort="50.0" velocity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Inner track door: slides in -X, passing behind the outer door -->
  <joint name="door_right_slide" type="prismatic">

    <origin xyz="0.44 -0.175 0.97" rpy="0 0 0"/>

</robot>
